summary: Privacy preferences with required and optional categories, plus accept and reject.
whenToUse: Collecting explicit choices for privacy categories.
whenNotToUse: As a substitute for a privacy notice, legal assessment or consent management platform.

props.name: categories
props.description: Categories with optional description and required flag.

props.name: value / defaultValue / onChange
props.description: Ids of the active choices; optional categories are off by default.

props.name: onSave
props.description: Saves the explicit choices through the consumer.

accessibility: Required categories are marked and cannot be changed.
customization: Colors and spacing come from tokens.
commonMistakes: Enabling optional categories without consent, or saving choices only in memory.
limits: Privacy notice, legal basis, tracker blocking and persistence are the consumer's responsibility.
